protocol.cache: RocksDB and OS caches retained; no result cache; no forced cold run

protocol.order: seeded shuffle of all query, method and repetition jobs
protocol.query_embeddings: frozen once and reused by every vector mode; no encoder inside DB
reported_metrics: source, candidate, graph and affinity work
protocol.scope_of_evidence: Fresh-to-campaign reserved comparison on 200 public development questions. Not hidden test, model-training exclusion, or agent-task evidence. No default admission without assessing uncertainty, category regressions and operating cost.
protocol.warmup: one fixed development query once per method; excluded from metrics

resources.scope: entire server process during measured requests; one-second RSS sampling, OS process CPU counter; no per-method attribution

retained_private_evidence: Full current source payloads, embedding receipts, typed path proofs, scope bindings, process samples and frozen vectors are bound by the recorded hashes; excluded from this public export.
